_doc: Engine schema for Cozy Chores "Open House" project "bouquet" (GDD 4, 6, 7, 13). Built by cozy-chores-tools/build-projects.mjs from farin-lxd's content-chores-bouquet.json; words come from content/bouquet.json by line role (a role 'x' in station 's' = the line whose id ends in '.s.x', or the full id). Stand-in art lives in "art" until art/manifest.json lists the real file.

objects._doc: farin-lxd 2026-10-29 (lines obj.bouquet.*): target words + tr / fa / en glosses.

bouquet._doc: The bouquet as the learner made it: the stems in their spiral order, the paper, the ribbon in the chosen colour.

plate-flower-wide.name: Flower shop, wide
plate-flower-wide.desc: Rosa’s flower shop at street level of number 12, morning: buckets of flowers along the walls, a wooden counter, the shop door with a bell on the left, the Street Party calendar pinned by the till. Morning light.

plate-flower-counter-two.name: Flower shop counter, over your shoulder
plate-flower-counter-two.desc: Over the shoulder across the counter; Ben (cut-out) on the other side, flowers on shelves behind him.

plate-flower-coldroom-pov.name: Cold room, eye level
plate-flower-coldroom-pov.desc: POV in the cold room: tall metal buckets of roses (pink, cream, white), a pot of rosemary by the door, a sunflower bucket; the arm basket on a bench at the bottom (target). Cool morning light, still bright.

plate-flower-bench-top.name: Work bench, from above
plate-flower-bench-top.desc: Straight down on the wooden bench: a cutting board, shears, stems laid out; noon light.

plate-flower-phone-close.name: The shop phone, close
plate-flower-phone-close.desc: Close on the counter by the till: the old shop phone (cut-out), the order book, a jar of ribbons. Noon.

plate-flower-arrange-close.name: The spiral in the hand, close
plate-flower-arrange-close.desc: Close, three-quarter view over the bench: the bouquet held up in a spiral (cut-outs); buckets and the ribbon spool on the bench edge. Afternoon light. (A close shot, not top-down, so Captain may visit: GDD 13 Q18.)

plate-flower-wrap-close.name: Wrapping paper and ribbons, close
plate-flower-wrap-close.desc: Close on the bench with brown paper, four ribbon reels (cut-outs) and the spool; afternoon sun.

plate-harbour-steps-wide.name: The harbour steps, Saturday 11:00
plate-harbour-steps-wide.desc: The stone harbour steps, golden late-morning light, boats, gulls, wedding guests out of focus; Hana, her gran and Ben are cut-outs. Brightest frame of the project (CZ8).

co-bq-paper.name: brown paper cone
co-bq-paper.desc: the bouquet’s brown paper, behind the stems

co-bq-ribbon.name: bouquet ribbon (white, tinted in code)
co-bq-ribbon.desc: drawn white: the engine tints it with the chosen ribbon colour

co-rosa-photo.name: old photo: Rosa as a girl under the counter, 1990
co-rosa-photo.desc: a faded 1990 snapshot taped behind the till: a girl sitting under this same counter (CZ12 curio)

co-sea-lavender.name: sea lavender with a paper tag
co-sea-lavender.desc: a small bucket of sea lavender, a paper tag tied on: Edie Crane / Elvira Cueto (the name on the tag is live HTML) (CZ12 curio)

co-ada-scissors.name: children’s scissors (purple handle)
co-ada-scissors.desc: a tiny pair of children’s scissors with a purple handle: Ada’s (CZ12 curio)

co-rose-yellow-bunch.name: yellow roses (a bunch of three)
co-rose-yellow-bunch.desc: the fourth colour for the A1 pick; same bunch and bucket style as the pink, cream and white bunches

plate-flower-crate-close.name: The wrong delivery: a crate of lilies, close
plate-flower-crate-close.desc: Close in the cold room: an open wooden crate full of bright orange lilies (part of the plate); the lid and the delivery note lying on top are cut-outs. Cool morning light, still bright.

co-crate-lid.name: crate lid
co-crate-lid.desc: the wooden lid of the crate; hides the lilies until the learner taps it

co-delivery-note.name: delivery note
co-delivery-note.desc: a printed delivery note with two lines of text (the words are spoken as captions; leave the lines blank or as ruled lines)

co-sunflower-buttonhole.name: sunflower buttonhole
co-sunflower-buttonhole.desc: one small sunflower pinned to the lapel of Ben’s suit (C1, bouquet.sunflower); drawn to sit on his portrait
